packageTitle: Khatu Shyam Ji - Salasar Balaji - Jaipur
duration: Khatu Shyam Ji - Salasar Balaji - Jaipur 2N/3D
inclusions: 2 nights' accommodation in 3-star hotels: 1 night in Khatu Shyam Ji, 1 night in Jaipur
Private air-conditioned vehicle for the entire itinerary.
Transfers between Jaipur, Khatu Shyam Ji and Salasar Balaji.
Jaipur sightseeing as per the itinerary.
Driver allowance, fuel, tolls and parking charges.
All transfers and sightseeing on a private basis.

days.title: Day 1 - Jaipur Airport to Khatu Shyam Ji
activities: Meet and greet by the driver/representative.
Private transfer to Khatu Shyam Ji (approximately 80 km).
Check in to the hotel and relax.
Overnight stay in Khatu Shyam Ji.

days.title: Day 2 - Khatu Shyam Ji Darshan - Salasar Balaji - Jaipur
activities: Proceed for Shri Khatu Shyam Ji Temple Darshan and seek blessings.
Check out from the hotel and drive to Salasar Balaji Temple.
Visit Salasar Balaji Temple and seek blessings of Lord Hanuman.
Continue the journey to Jaipur and check in to the hotel.
Evening at leisure or explore the nearby local market.

days.title: Day 3 - Jaipur Sightseeing - Airport Drop
activities: Breakfast at the hotel and check out.
Proceed for Jaipur sightseeing, covering: Amber Fort, Jal Mahal, City Palace, Jantar Mantar, Hawa Mahal (photo stop).
Enjoy free time for shopping or local exploration, depending on flight timings.
Transfer to Jaipur International Airport for your onward journey.
